entries.note: baseline snapshot at adoption of skill-provenance/v1
inject shared interaction-policy v1 managed region
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata, and make the bundled analyzer command plugin-location independent

replace the bootstrap-CI significance gate (a non-negative spread whose CI clears zero even under pure noise) with a label-shuffled permutation null, and report a per-knob effect instead of copying the run-level heldout delta onto every knob

entry point for a guided first run's traigent-runs/optimized-results.json (save_to dump -> one trial per line) and an explicit rule for the under-20-trial arrival state: every knob is directional, present as knobs to test next, never rerun the search to reach 20, and leave --heldout off when only one selected configuration was scored on the held-out rows. Script unchanged.

rebase PR #288 onto current main and sync interaction-policy v2: recommend next skills only after result-bearing steps or explicit decisions, cap recommendations at three, and attach one eligibility reason per recommendation
Rebuild issue #150 on current main: require --objective to match the trial metric key and explain that empty or all-directional importance means insufficient variation.

Apply Holm correction across all eligible knobs before ranking, expose raw and adjusted inference metadata, guard per-knob support and permutation resolution, and require explicit randomized sampling for confirmed-effect labels.
Keep the generic example at unknown sampling, define evidence required for randomized sampling, use association language, and preserve full precision for inferential values.
Reject invalid objective and cost measurements before inference and count floating-point permutation ties with a scale-relative tolerance.
Scale the permutation tie tolerance by the group means so large-offset objectives keep true ties, and apply the finite-number rule to heldout report values.
Skip failed, pruned and cancelled trials (status not completed) instead of ranking their placeholder scores, and report the skipped count.

Add --alpha (default 0.05) decoupled from the display-only --confidence, keep knobs assigned together with another knob directional, and write the SDK cross-check to sdk_cross_check.json and insights.md.
Raise the default permutation draws to 2000 so a 10-knob family can still be labelled significant at the new default alpha, and document --bootstrap-draws with its resolution rule.
